engine.ai.noPdfContent: This AI file has no PDF-compatible copy — it contains only AI-specific data and a notice page, so Omniweave cannot open the artwork. In the program that made it, turn on the 'Create PDF Compatible File' option, save again, and then open it.
engine.ai.previewOnly: Showing only the small preview stored in the file — the artwork cannot be edited and is not saved back as an AI file.
engine.pdf.form.xfa: This is an XFA form and cannot be filled — it opens read-only.
engine.pdf.form.readOnly: Form field “{name}” is read-only and was not changed.
engine.pdf.annot.noPage: Page {page} does not exist; its annotations were not added.
engine.pdf.annot.noImage: A signature picture was missing and was not added.
engine.ai.saveNote: This edit cannot be carried into the AI-specific data ({reason}), so the file is saved from the PDF content without the AI-specific data (PieceInfo). Reopened in that program, the layers merge into one, hidden and non-printing layer contents are lost, and text opens in fragments. Changing only text characters, or only a shape's fill colour, stroke colour or stroke width, keeps the layers and text.
engine.pdf.edit.charsDropped: "{chars}": removed because these characters are in neither the original nor the fallback font
engine.pdf.edit.colorMismatch: "{name}": the shape edit was written, but the color read back differs, so it is treated as not applied
engine.pdf.edit.contentUnreadable: Couldn't read the page content: {error} — left as is
engine.pdf.edit.cropIgnored: Page cropping is not applied when saving with PDF surgery (original format) — use the PDF Document export to save the cropped look
engine.pdf.edit.degenerateMatrix: "{name}": the transform matrix is degenerate, so the original is kept
engine.pdf.edit.formRecursion: Form XObject nesting is too deep or circular ({key})
engine.pdf.edit.noFallbackFont: "{text}": removed because the characters are not in the original font and there is no fallback font
engine.pdf.edit.objectUnsupported: "{name}" ({type}): PDF surgery save does not write this object — use the PDF Document export
engine.pdf.edit.rootNotIndirect: The page tree root is not an indirect object
engine.pdf.edit.streamTooLarge: The decompressed stream is too large (over {mb} MB) — treated as damaged or malicious data and left as is
engine.pdf.edit.syntaxError: Content stream syntax error ({key}): {error} — this stream is left as is
engine.pdf.edit.tiffPredictor: The TIFF predictor is supported for 8 bits only
engine.pdf.edit.tooManyPaths: Too many vector paths ({n}); they are left in the background (maximum {max})
engine.pdf.edit.verifyFailed: Couldn't re-read and verify the edited shapes: {error}
engine.pdf.fallbackChars: {n} characters missing from the original (subset) font were embedded in Pretendard for those parts only: {chars}
engine.pdf.fallbackChars_one: {n} character missing from the original (subset) font was embedded in Pretendard for that part only: {chars}
engine.pdf.needPassword: This PDF is password-protected — an open password is required
engine.pdf.noEncryptDict: The encryption dictionary cannot be found
engine.pdf.noModify: The author of this PDF does not allow changes (security permissions) — it can be edited and saved only when opened with the owner password
engine.pdf.noOU: The encryption dictionary has no O/U values
engine.pdf.noStartxref: The PDF has no startxref, so it cannot be saved incrementally
engine.pdf.otherEngineVersion: {name}: this page was made editable by a different version of the PDF surgery engine, so it cannot be saved in its original format — use the PDF Document export
engine.pdf.pageDamaged: The object for page {page} is damaged
engine.pdf.sourceMissing: The original PDF page cannot be found
engine.print.edgesClipped: Pages larger than the paper have their edges cut off
engine.print.frameNotReady: Couldn't prepare the PDF print window
engine.print.noPages: There are no pages to print
engine.print.photoShrunk: The {photo} photo is larger than {paper} paper, so it was shrunk to fit
engine.pw.pdfMessage: Enter the password to open the PDF
engine.tools.cannotShrinkNoImages: Cannot reduce further — a PDF without images is mostly fonts and text, so there is little to gain (original kept)
engine.tools.cannotShrinkOptimized: Cannot reduce further — the PDF is already optimized or its images are too small to benefit from recompression (original kept)
engine.tools.heic: This app's built-in browser engine (WebView2) cannot decode HEIC — set your phone to "Most Compatible" (JPG) or export JPG from your photos app
engine.tools.needsConversion: {name}: the {mime} format needs to be converted first
engine.tools.nothingToMerge: There are no PDFs to merge
engine.tools.pageTooLarge: Page {page} is too large to render at this resolution — lower the resolution
engine.ai.why.data: the object was not found in the AI data: {detail}
engine.open.aiNative: Opened {n} artboards of an AI file saved without a PDF-compatible copy, drawn from the AI file's own data
engine.open.aiNative_one: Opened {n} artboard of an AI file saved without a PDF-compatible copy, drawn from the AI file's own data
engine.ai.native.opened: This file has no PDF-compatible copy, so it was drawn by reading the AI file's own data. You can view it and fix it with Edit PDF Text, but it is not saved back as AI (.ai) — export it to another format, or open a copy re-saved with the 'Create PDF Compatible File' option on in the program that made it.
engine.ai.native.placedPreview: {n} linked images were drawn from the preview kept in the file (low resolution) instead of the original picture files.
engine.ai.native.placedMissing: {n} linked images have no preview in the file and were not drawn.
engine.ai.native.foreign: {n} objects the AI file imported from a PDF and keeps apart (ForeignObject) were drawn from that PDF content.
engine.ai.native.foreignMissing: {n} objects the AI file imported from a PDF and keeps apart (ForeignObject) could not be read and were not drawn.
engine.ai.native.rasterUnknown: {n} raster images in a format that could not be read were not drawn.
engine.ai.native.rasterTruncated: {n} raster images with cut-off data were not drawn.
engine.ai.native.textPath: {n} texts on a path were placed along the path approximately (glyph rotation and spacing may differ slightly).
engine.ai.native.textUnread: {n} texts could not be read from the AI file's text data and were not drawn.
engine.ai.native.gradientMissing: {n} gradients without a definition were not drawn.
engine.ai.native.symbolMissing: {n} symbol instances without a definition (or damaged) were not drawn.
engine.ai.native.patternMissing: {n} pattern fills without a definition were not drawn.
engine.ai.native.damaged: Part of the AI file's data is damaged; the art was drawn up to that point.
engine.ai.native.tooLarge: There were too many objects to draw; the rest were left out (damaged or excessively large data).
engine.ai.native.other: {n} AI objects could not be read and were not drawn.
engine.ai.native.fonts: Fonts are not included in the file; they are drawn with the installed fonts of the same name: {fonts}
engine.pdf.mergedSave: {n} pages taken from other files, new or copied are put in their places and the whole file is written again (not an update appended to the original).
engine.pdf.drawnPages: {n} pages that are not PDF pages were drawn as the PDF export draws them.
engine.pdf.otherPagesLeft: An AI file cannot take the {n} pages taken from other files or added; they are left out. Use Export ▸ PDF document to keep them all.
engine.pdf.edit.gradientKept: Changes to the gradient shape '{name}' are not written into the PDF yet; it was kept as it was (deleting it works)
